Problem Statement
Read three integers and print their sum, by directly adding the three values together.
Description
Read three integers a, b and c from input. Add all three values together using the + operator and store the result in a variable. Print the resulting sum. No loop is needed since the count of numbers is fixed at three.
Input Description
Three integers a, b and c separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the sum of a, b and c.
Sample Input
2 4 6
Sample Output
12
